headings.text: 3\. When we share information about you

dropped.item: Service providers and processors, such as hosting providers, cloud infrastructure providers, analytics providers, security providers, communication providers, customer support providers and payment-related service providers
Professional advisers, such as legal, accounting, audit and compliance advisers
Advertising and measurement partners, subject to your choices and applicable law
Integration partners, when you choose to connect a partner service to BeReal
Public authorities, courts, law enforcement or other third parties where required or permitted by law
Another entity in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization, asset sale or similar transaction
